title: Weight Ruler
description: A weight log with an 801-tick ruler that only mounts the ticks near the needle, and a readout, BMI band and chart that follow it frame by frame.
steps: Each tick is `itemSize` 12 and stands for 0.1 kg, from 40.0 to 120.0; `defaultIndex` 284 opens on 68.4 kg.
`renderWindowSize={80}` keeps only the ticks around the needle mounted, and `snapMode="nearest"` with `snapMomentum` 0.3 lets a flick travel.
`progress` feeds derived values on the UI thread: the kg and BMI text, the WHO band marker and today's bar update every frame without a React render.
